row: Scratching Florida Lotto For Pet Rescues

Goal of this channel is to raise money for Pet Rescues.  When we scratch lotto tickets the money is used to keep channel going and shared with Pet rescues. If you have a rescue of choice let us know!!!
 


Our email is Kwazytown56@gmail.com.  

If you would like for us to scratch one of your States tickets on our videos please email us and we would so appreciate the support  You sharing your tickets helps us to do videos.  All tickets sent to us ARE SENT BACK to that person with our gratitude for helping us 

Pleaseeee. LIKE. SUBSCRIBE and SHARE
